# Deep Research Intelligence Drop — Worldpay Supplemental Account Depth Audit

## Batch receipt

- Date: 2026-09-30
- Scope: One bounded audit of the 85 accounts added from the Worldpay ABM backbook.
- Purpose: Separate brand-wide footprint from the exact Worldpay merchant/entity footprint, normalize obviously inconsistent operating segments, and expose missing Worldpay relationship ownership.
- Usage gate: Eligible at start (36% five-hour and 55% weekly usage consumed); research was bounded to seven public-footprint validations plus portfolio-wide classification and governance cleanup.

## Pages checked and observations added

| Account | Observation | Scope | Confidence | Source |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf | Official directory reports 193 U.S. locations. | U.S. brand footprint; WP merchant scope still unknown | 90% | https://www.coffeebean.com/store/index.html |
| Caribou Coffee | Company states more than 800 locations in 11 countries. | Global brand footprint; numbered WP record may be one merchant/site | 85% | https://www.cariboucoffee.com/about-us/ |
| Jamba | Official directory reports 720 U.S. locations. | U.S. brand footprint | 90% | https://locations.jamba.com/ |
| Hungry Howie's | Company states nearly 500 stores in 18 states. | Approximate U.S. brand footprint | 90% | https://hungryhowies.com/about-us |
| Carvel | Official directory reports 374 U.S. locations. | U.S. brand footprint | 90% | https://locations.carvel.com/ |
| Bruegger's | Bagel Brands reported 181 locations as of October 2023. | Brand footprint; dated | 75% | https://www.brueggers.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/BB-ESG-Report-2023.pdf |
| Uno Pizzeria & Grill | Company states 100 restaurants in 20 states, D.C. and international markets. | Global brand footprint | 90% | https://unos.com/about/ |

## Portfolio-wide findings

- 64 of 85 supplemental rows initially lacked any location count.
- All 85 supplemental rows lacked a named RM or Worldpay relationship owner.
- A material share are legal entities, franchisees, numbered stores, licensed sites, or holding companies. Applying a brand-wide count to those records would overstate the scope of Worldpay's relationship.
- Existing source segments mixed cuisine, service model, ownership type and channel. The workbook now normalizes obvious cases while preserving an explicit account-type field.
- Every supplemental row now asks: who at Worldpay owns the relationship, what merchant IDs/legal entities are included, and whether the relationship is enterprise, franchisee or single-site?

## Conflicts and negative findings

- A public brand footprint does not prove Worldpay processes all locations.
- Numbered records such as Caribou Coffee #1243, Friendly Ice Cream #7776, Robek's #289 and Smashburger #1567 may represent individual merchants/sites; their brand footprint is context, not WP scope.
- Public counts for Bruegger's are dated and should be refreshed before a formal forecast.
- No reliable internal owner was found for the 85 supplemental rows; ownership remains an explicit Worldpay meeting question rather than an inferred assignment.

## Remaining follow-up

1. Worldpay supplies relationship owner, merchant/legal entity and enterprise/franchise/site scope for every supplemental row.
2. Research the remaining brand/chain rows with missing footprints, prioritizing A/B meeting accounts.
3. Park unresolved legal-entity rows unless Worldpay confirms multi-unit or enterprise buying authority.
4. Once scope is confirmed, convert only the qualified subset into scored opportunities.
